title: no-test-regression rubric conflicts with HARD RULE 1 test update allowance
description: The no-test-regression rubric pass condition 'no test file edited' conflicts with HARD RULE 1, which explicitly permits updating test code to the minimum extent needed to compile against a new implementation. When a public API changes (adding a required struct field), test files must be updated to compile. The kernel forces no-test-regression to fail even when all tests pass and edits are strictly minimal.
proposed_resolution: Update run.rubrics.md to exempt test file edits that are strictly required for compilation (no test deletion or weakening) from the no-test-regression failure condition.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash (cargo_test)
description: Used Bash to run cargo test in src/moeb/ for build and test verification. No moeb tool exists for executing the project test suite, forcing moeb-tool-origin Fail.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a run_tests tool that executes cargo test in a specified directory and returns the result.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (start_run result file)
description: Used Read (Claude Code built-in) to read the oversized start_run output saved to an absolute host path. The moeb read_file tool only reads relative paths from the project working directory and cannot access this path.
proposed_resolution: Extend start_run to return large content via a moeb-accessible relative path, or add a moeb tool for reading kernel-generated output files by run_id.
